# jamfplatform_pro_renew_mdm_profile (Action)

Renews the MDM enrollment profile on one or more mobile devices.

**Required Jamf permissions**

Grant the API integration the following permissions in Jamf Account — see [Getting started with the Platform API](https://developer.jamf.com/platform-api/reference/getting-started-with-platform-api). `Category` and `Permission` name the section and row of the permission picker; `Actions` are the boxes to tick within that row.

| Category | Permission | Actions | API capability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Device actions | Device actions | Execute | `device-actions` |

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "jamfplatform_pro_renew_mdm_profile" "renew" {
  config {
    # Hardware UDIDs, e.g. data.jamfplatform_device.example.hardware_udid
    udids = [
      "00000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
    ]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `udids` (List of String) Hardware UDIDs of the mobile devices. Source these from the `jamfplatform_device` data source `hardware_udid` attribute.
